# Are your Kubernetes requests wasting money?

> Paste kubectl top output, kubectl get pods JSON or a simple CSV and see which containers request far more CPU and memory than they use, a recommended request with headroom, the monthly saving, out-of-memory risk and YAML patches. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [How to right-size Kubernetes resource requests](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/k8s-requests-rightsizer/how-to-right-size-kubernetes-resource-requests.html)
